content: ब्राह्मण्य {%a.%} Befitting a Brāhmaṇa. .{@-ण्यः@} An epithet of the planet Saturn. .{@-ण्यम्@} .²1 The station or rank of a Brāhmaṇa, priestly or sacerdotal character; सत्यं शपे ब्राह्मण्येन <ls>Mk. 5</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 66</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 17</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7. 42</ls>. .²2 A collection of Brāhmaṇas; ब्राह्मण्यं कृत्स्नमेतत्त्वां ब्रह्मण्यमनुगच्छति <ls>Rām. 2. 45. 21</ls>.
